notes: Oorjaa is a Shopify storefront (robots.txt: 'Allow: /', no Claude-specific disallow) selling handcrafted lamps/lights made from paper, cork, cement, wood etc. Investigated via direct HTTP tier only (no JS rendering needed, Shopify serves full data via JSON endpoints and XML sitemaps). Steps taken: (1) Pulled full collections.json (limit=250, single page returned, 65 total collections) — every collection title/handle listed is organized by lamp type (table/wall/ceiling/floor/pendant/hanging), room (bedroom/living room/study), material (wooden/cork/cement/paper), style/collection-line (Wabi Sabi, Urbania, Elements, Lantana, Shadow Play, Fibre Fables, Uncork, Dori), origin (Global/Overseas lamps), GST-rate groupings (12% GST, 18% GST), and merchandising buckets (Best Sellers, New Additions, High Value Products). Zero collections reference any holiday/festival (no Diwali, Christmas, New Year, Holi, Raksha Bandhan/Rakhi, Eid, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, Easter, Mother's Day, or Father's Day in any title or handle). (2) Cross-checked against sitemap_collections_1.xml — identical set of 65 collection URLs, confirming collections.json is exhaustive and nothing is hidden/unpublished-from-API. (3) Checked sitemap_pages_1.xml for any festive landing page: found /pages/gifting (a generic 'Gifting' landing page, not a PLP) — its internal links all point to the same standard product-type/material/style collections already enumerated above, none occasion-specific, so even as a non-PLP landing page it would not qualify. Also found /pages/annual-bright-side-sale (storewide sale page, explicitly excluded by rules) and /pages/events (design-fair event recaps, not seasonal). No gift-guide or holiday page exists. (4) Ran on-site search (/search?q=...&type=product&view=json) for diwali, christmas, new-year, holi, raksha-bandhan, rakhi, eid, valentine, thanksgiving, easter, mothers-day, fathers-day, gifting, festive as a supplementary absence check (not relied upon alone, since nav/sitemap were already checked first per rules). 'diwali' returned 14 generic full-text hits (random lamps like Cocoon Floor Lamp, Manhattan Floor Lamp, Elephant Shadow Play Lamp — ordinary catalog items with no occasion-specific naming or dedicated collection, i.e. the word appears somewhere in body copy such as gifting suggestions, not a taxonomy match); 'new-year', 'holi', 'raksha-bandhan', 'rakhi', 'easter', 'thanksgiving', 'festive', 'gifting' returned small numbers of similarly generic full-text token matches (e.g. 'holi' partial-matching 'holiday'/similar substrings); 'christmas', 'eid', 'valentine', 'mothers-day', 'fathers-day' returned 0 results. None of these searches surfaced any hidden dedicated collection page. Given the exhaustive collections.json + sitemap cross-check already proves there is no seasonal taxonomy node anywhere on the site (a stronger signal than search), and despite Oorjaa being an Indian lighting retailer where Diwali Lighting would be the most likely candidate, the site's own taxonomy does not present Diwali or any other holiday as a distinct category. Conclusion: no genuine seasonal/holiday category exists on this site as of 2026-09-04.
